Repeating the above procedure for the numbers to the left and right of $x _ { i }$ respectively, · · · , until the numbers $\{ x _ { 1 } , x _ { 2 } , \cdots , x _ { n } \}$ are placed in an increasing order as $x _ { ( 1 ) } < x _ { ( 2 ) } < \cdot \cdot \cdot < x _ { ( n ) }$ . Using probabilistic argument $( \mathrm { e . g . }$ conditional expectation) to evaluate roughly the average number of steps (each step is a comparing of two numbers) needed to complete the task for large n.
